content.source: export const handler=async(input)=>{const fact=input.dimensions?.company_category_evidence||input.dimensions?.target_category_procurement_evidence||{};const ids=Array.isArray(fact.evidence_ids)?fact.evidence_ids.filter(Boolean):[];const observed=String(fact.state||'UNKNOWN').toUpperCase()==='OBSERVED'&&ids.length>0;const scope=String(input.scope_status||'').toUpperCase();const basis=String(input.match_basis||'').toUpperCase();const explicitMismatch=input.confirmed_category_mismatch===true||input.confirmed_unrelated_assortment===true||(observed&&basis==='OUT_OF_SCOPE'&&Number(fact.points)===0);let category_confirmation_status='MATCH_NOT_CONFIRMED';let category_confirmation_reason='CATEGORY_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED';let category_confirmation_message='尚未确认该公司经营目标类目';if(explicitMismatch){category_confirmation_status='MISMATCH_CONFIRMED';category_confirmation_reason='CATEGORY_MISMATCH';category_confirmation_message='已确认该公司不经营目标类目';}else if(observed&&scope==='MATCHED'){category_confirmation_status='MATCH_CONFIRMED';category_confirmation_reason='TARGET_CATEGORY_MATCH';category_confirmation_message='已确认该公司经营目标类目';}const matchStatus=category_confirmation_status==='MATCH_CONFIRMED'?'CATEGORY_MATCH_CONFIRMED':category_confirmation_status==='MISMATCH_CONFIRMED'?'CATEGORY_MISMATCH':'CATEGORY_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED';return{category_confirmation_status,category_confirmation_reason,category_confirmation_message,match_status:matchStatus,company_category_evidence_ids:ids,product_profile_optional:true,calculation_version:'category-company-match-v3'};};
